_comment: Single source of truth for the alex-main-agent Slack app.
A Slack app runs ONE transport at a time. With Socket Mode enabled, a slash
command that still carries a request URL fails at invocation with
'invalid_url' -- so the two transports need genuinely different app configs
and no single manifest can serve both.
Both manifests are rendered from this file by scripts/render_manifest.py so
the commands, scopes and descriptions cannot drift apart between them.
Edit this file, then run: make render
name: alex-main-agent
description: Scoped ORESoftware work intake for Claude and ChatGPT through the AI bridge and coordinator.

commands.name: x-ores-claude
commands.description: Submit a scoped ORESoftware task to Claude.
commands.usage_hint: [task] or leave empty to open the scoped task menu

commands.name: x-ores-chatgpt
commands.description: Submit a scoped ORESoftware task to ChatGPT.
commands.usage_hint: [task] or leave empty to open the scoped task menu
